purpose: Historical protocol calibration, not new evaluation labels or a confirmatory benchmark.

selection.rationale: Missing dev question; first historical dev monthly-change and negative-value questions by ID; two already-public ranking examples. Purposive development examples, not a representative sample or outcome-blind new dataset.

business_rules: 历史题面、证据与回答按 v1 原样保存。负交易金额不等于可确认的实物退货；业务命名问题单列，不偷偷改 gold。
先识别中性的事实片段，再记录完整关系。amount 是类型，malformed 是格式判断；不能把错误结论塞进类型名。
数据行忠实度与完整关系分别判断：产品对应金额抄对，仍可能处在错误排名。不能因后面的产品排错，就断言先生成的序号 token 本身应当不确定。
关系至少记录时期、实体、指标、排名或比较、金额和单位；没有说出的字段留空，不从 gold 补写。继承题面时期时标明 question 来源。
所有字符区间只针对完整回答，采用 Unicode code points，start 含、end 不含。关系可连接多个不连续片段，最晚证据字符位置决定完整关系何时才可被判断。
supported/contradicted 必须引用表中证据行并解释。解析不清、范围不足或因果/建议无法判断时使用 needs_review；unmatched 只用于可解析且已明确完整搜索范围仍无匹配的事实。
记录所有会影响业务判断的陈述，包括重复、后文自相矛盾、额外建议和解释；同一关系重复出现用同一个 claim_group 和 repeat，不把一个错绑扩写成多个独立错误。
精确值、显示舍入匹配和仅落在旧容差内分开记录。旧金额容差为 max(1 GBP, 0.5% of |reference|)，百分比为 0.5 percentage points；新关系协议尚未据此形成评分规则。
并列排名、负数符号、百分比分母、部分月份与商品范围必须核对；不根据语气、流畅度、旧标签或 detector scores 判断。
先记录是否看过原案例或标签。隐藏文件字段不消除既往接触，也不能证明独立人工标注。审查页不包含 gold、旧标注边界、split、Qwen uncertainty 或检测结果。

boundaries.historical_label_policy: Original 205 spans stay immutable. Any q_0048 v1 atomic-label sensitivity must be a separate reviewed version, not an automatic translation of this v2 relation draft.
boundaries.reviewer_provenance: Reviewer identity/type/exposure are self-reported, not verified human-review evidence. Assistant tests use synthetic fixtures and never populate real reviews.
boundaries.future_comparison: No detector sees review verdicts. Online token scoring and completed-answer relation checking have different information budgets. No verifier is implemented by this protocol.
boundaries.numeric_policy: Calibration records exact/display/legacy-tolerance categories separately. Do not silently change the historical tolerance or apply a new relation threshold to historical test results.
boundaries.rollout_gate: Owner calibration and policy revision first, then independent reviewer packets; no scaling or scoring until coverage and disagreements are reviewed.
